views.name: hull_rig
findings: The preserved three lateen masts/yards, low open battery and pointed afterbody are clearly distinct, with visible standing/running lines between the spars and side fittings.
Longitudinal hull grain, the populated open deck, outboard rig fittings and stowed anchor gear are readable in the intact whole-GLB view.
views.scope: Whole actual GLB with all visible hull, rig and sails.

views.name: deck_closeup
findings: At the matched 4.5 m field, directional plank grain, staggered seams, coaming thickness, individual stair treads and rope handrails are readable through the actual open hatch.
Worn iron barrels, trunnions, timber carriages/wheels and small banded tackle blocks have distinct physical detail; retained deck tackle lines remain actual geometry.
views.scope: Actual deck and fitting close-up at a fixed 4.5 metre physical field; rig hidden for visibility.

views.name: hold_interior
findings: The fitted cask has distinct staves, iron hoops and a timber head; a diagonal-braced planked provisions box and framed glass lantern are visible on the opposite side.
The intact hold resolves fine sole-board grain, curved ribs, longitudinal inner strakes, overhead beams/knees and the actual mast step, with the hatch stair retained in the background.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: hold_cutaway
findings: The declared hull/upper-deck cutaway exposes the long repeated-frame structure, inner longitudinal timbers, real access stair, mast framing and compact side-stowage arrangement.
This bright wide image is a structural supplement; material finish is assessed in the intact close-ups. All temporarily hidden meshes are listed and the delivered GLB is unchanged.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

views.name: cabin_interior
findings: The modest cuddy contains an actual planked storage seat with thick lid/iron hardware and a framed lantern; fine sole/wall grain, curved ribs, inner stringers and overhead knees remain visible.
The actual companion doorway/treads and the small high forward two-pane casement are visible in the intact room. Seating and storage share the compact fitted locker as documented.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: cabin_cutaway
findings: The declared cutaway exposes the compact storage-seat/lantern arrangement and the narrowing sole within the preserved pointed afterbody.
Curved ribs, longitudinal inner timbers and sole-board edges remain actual geometry, making the limited cuddy floor area inspectable without widening the hull.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.
